docs_facts.fact: Organization-level reporting for Claude Console accounts: GET /v1/organizations/usage_report/messages (token usage; buckets 1m, 1h, 1d; filter/group by api key, workspace, model, service tier, context window, data residency, speed) and GET /v1/organizations/cost_report (USD as decimal strings in cents; excludes Priority Tier, which you read from the usage endpoint by service_tier). Needs an Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-...), org:admin OAuth token, or unscoped key; workspace keys fail; unavailable to individual accounts. Claude Enterprise uses the Analytics API; per-user Claude Code cost uses the Claude Code Analytics API.
docs_facts.exam_era_risk: API version 2026-10-21 renames several Admin API response fields (e.g. workspace_id on API keys becomes scope).

docs_facts.fact: Org Owners set Claude Code policy in claude.ai Organization settings > Claude Code > Managed settings; clients fetch at startup and poll hourly. Needs Claude for Teams or Enterprise, Owner/Primary Owner role, and network access to api.anthropic.com. Managed settings sit at the top of the precedence stack and a lower scope cannot override them (a few restrictive keys are exceptions). A managed-mcp.json cannot be delivered this way; use allowedMcpServers/deniedMcpServers keys. Endpoint-managed alternatives: MDM/OS policy or a managed-settings.json file.
Plan on which server-managed settings are available (together with Enterprise). Other Teams plan details: not verified.

Plan on which server-managed settings are available (together with Teams); Enterprise cost/usage reporting goes through the Claude Enterprise Analytics API rather than the Admin API. Other plan details: not verified.

Set to 1 to turn on OpenTelemetry export; required for any telemetry. Exporter variables set in a repository's .claude/settings.json or settings.local.json are ignored, so only user, managed or shell settings can enable or route telemetry. Prompt text is not logged unless OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1.

Claude Code exports metrics (time series), events via the logs/events protocol, and beta traces. Exporter choices: otlp, prometheus (metrics only), console, none. Protocols for otlp: grpc, http/json, http/protobuf; no default protocol, so you must set one. Metrics include claude_code.session.count, claude_code.cost.usage, claude_code.token.usage, claude_code.lines_of_code.count, claude_code.commit.count, claude_code.pull_request.count, claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision, claude_code.active_time.total. Setting a generic endpoint in managed settings strips developer-set per-signal endpoints.

Selects metrics exporters, comma-separated: otlp, prometheus, console, none (none disables). Logs use OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER (otlp, console, none). Export interval OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL defaults to 60000 ms. Selectors follow ordinary per-key precedence, so set them in managed settings to lock them.
